verdict.rationale: Yapily's Data API returns consented account details (docs-15, docs-34, docs-27), and it separately offers instant account-ownership confirmation (docs-4). Together these approximate verified bank identifiers without micro-deposits, but the evidence never states that account or routing numbers (sort code, IBAN) are returned, and its payments run via Faster Payments/SEPA rather than ACH or bank-debit funding. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that account/routing identifiers (or tokens) are returned, ACH or direct-debit funding use of those identifiers, and independent corroboration.
